title: Pretty "Basic"
text: Pretty "Basic". These are plastic frames with a cheap finish. From a distance they don't look too bad. The corners are mitered well and they seem to be sturdy. I give away a lot of artwork and they will be useful for that, but by no means are they very expensive looking or particularly attractive.
